what: Pinnacle West is the parent of Arizona Public Service, the regulated electricity utility that serves most of Arizona including Phoenix. Rates are set by the state commission.
customers: Households and businesses in Arizona, who have no alternative supplier.
money: generation, transmission and distribution in Arizona
moat: A legal monopoly over electricity in its service territory, with rates set to earn a return on the money invested in the network.
risks: Free cash flow is negative by about $932M because capital spending exceeds earnings, by design
$13.5B of debt against almost no cash, so borrowing costs matter
The Arizona commission has been unpredictable, and a poor rate case hurts for years
opportunities: A 11.6% net margin guaranteed by the regulated return
Phoenix is one of the fastest-growing metro areas in America and data centres are arriving
Revenue grew from $3.8B to $5.3B in four years on customer growth and rate increases
watch: Rate case outcomes and customer growth in the Phoenix area.
